scholarships.title: Daet LGU Academic Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.description: For deserving students from Daet who are enrolled in any college degree program. Awarded to students who demonstrate academic excellence and financial need.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 5,000 per semester + school supplies allowance

scholarships.title: Daet LGU Freshman Incentive Grant
scholarships.description: Special grant for first-year college students from Daet who are enrolling for the first time. Designed to ease the financial burden during the critical first semester of college.

scholarships.title: Labo Municipal Scholarship Grant
scholarships.description: Open to all bonafide residents of Labo pursuing undergraduate studies. Priority given to students from low-income families.

scholarships.title: Labo IT and Technology Scholarship
scholarships.description: For Labo residents pursuing technology-related degree programs. Supports the municipality's goal of developing local tech talent for the digital economy.

scholarships.title: Vinzons Youth Development Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for youth residents of Vinzons enrolled in any recognized higher education institution. Aimed at developing the youth workforce of the municipality.

scholarships.title: Vinzons Education Excellence Award
scholarships.description: Prestigious award for third and fourth year students from Vinzons who have consistently maintained high academic standing throughout their college career.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 6,000 per semester + certificate of recognition

scholarships.title: Capalonga Municipal Education Assistance
scholarships.description: Education assistance program for Capalonga residents in financial need. Supports students in continuing their college education without interruption.

scholarships.title: Capalonga Nursing Scholarship
scholarships.description: Dedicated scholarship for Capalonga residents taking up Nursing. The municipality aims to address the shortage of healthcare workers in the local health centers.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 5,000 per semester + clinical supplies allowance

scholarships.title: Jose Panganiban Scholars Program
scholarships.description: For residents of Jose Panganiban pursuing technology and vocational courses. Prioritizes students aligned with the municipality's mining and industrial development goals.

scholarships.title: Jose Panganiban Engineering Scholarship
scholarships.description: For residents of Jose Panganiban taking up Engineering courses. Supports the municipality's infrastructure development goals by investing in future local engineers.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 6,000 per semester + engineering tools allowance

scholarships.title: Mercedes Municipal Scholarship Award
scholarships.description: Annual scholarship for academically outstanding students who are residents of Mercedes and enrolled in any state college or university.

scholarships.title: Mercedes Senior Year Completion Grant
scholarships.description: Special grant for fourth year students from Mercedes who are in their final year of college. Helps ensure students complete their degrees without financial disruption.

scholarships.title: Paracale Gold Scholars Grant
scholarships.description: Scholarship grant for Paracale residents pursuing undergraduate degrees. Named in honor of the municipality's gold mining heritage and commitment to education.

scholarships.title: Paracale CS and IT Scholars Program
scholarships.description: For Paracale residents enrolled in Computer Science or Information Technology. Supports students who will contribute to digital transformation and modernization of local industries.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 5,500 per semester + software tools allowance

scholarships.title: San Lorenzo Ruiz Educational Assistance Program
scholarships.description: In honor of the patron saint of the municipality, this program supports financially challenged students from San Lorenzo Ruiz in pursuing higher education.

scholarships.title: San Lorenzo Ruiz Education Scholarship for Teachers
scholarships.description: For residents of San Lorenzo Ruiz taking up Education courses. Encourages youth to pursue teaching and contribute to improving the quality of local basic education.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 4,500 per semester + teaching supplies allowance

scholarships.title: Santa Elena Academic Scholarship
scholarships.description: For bonafide residents of Santa Elena who are enrolled full-time in any CHED-recognized institution. Subject to good moral character and financial need assessment.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 4,000 per semester + miscellaneous fee coverage

scholarships.title: Santa Elena Sophomore Support Scholarship
scholarships.description: Targeted support for second year students from Santa Elena who passed their first year. Aims to prevent dropouts during the critical sophomore year.

scholarships.title: Talisay Municipal Education Grant
scholarships.description: Education grant for deserving students from Talisay. Covers basic tuition and living allowance to help students focus on their studies.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 3,500 per semester + PHP 1,000 monthly living allowance

scholarships.title: Talisay Agriculture and Fisheries Grant
scholarships.description: For residents of Talisay pursuing Agriculture or Fisheries courses. Supports the municipality's fishing and farming communities by investing in the next generation of agri-fishery professionals.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 4,500 per semester + farming tools allowance

scholarships.title: Basud Youth Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: For young residents of Basud who wish to pursue college education. Encourages youth participation in higher learning and community development.

scholarships.title: Basud Junior Year Academic Grant
scholarships.description: For third year students from Basud who have shown consistent academic performance. Recognizes dedication and encourages students to finish their degrees.

scholarships.title: Camarines Norte Provincial Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Province-wide scholarship open to all residents of Camarines Norte. Covers students from all 12 municipalities pursuing any undergraduate degree in a recognized institution.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 6,000 per semester + PHP 2,000 book allowance

scholarships.title: Camarines Norte IT Innovation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Provincial scholarship exclusively for IT and CS students. Part of the CamNorte Digital Futures initiative aimed at growing the local technology workforce.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 8,000 per semester + laptop and internet allowance
